title: Junior Legal Counsel
description:
Join Dropbox as a Junior Legal Counsel and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Junior Legal Counsel with strong expertise in general. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making

- Continuously improve processes and workflows

- Salary range: TTD 600,000 – TTD 1,000,000

- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
